race.comment: TAVI TIME (4) comes down from Sydney ready to peak third-up. He carried a big weight last time at Randwick and ran on well for third to some better-weighted horses. Gets J-Mac on and with any luck from the inside gate he'll go close. FEROCE (1) has been safely held in the G2 Crystal Mile and G1 Toorak Handicap of late but is going better than it looks and comes back a couple of notches which can see him return to the winner's circle. ENXUTO (7) was only fair in the G2 Crystal Mile, but 4th in this race last year reads well and the fresh run was excellent. He doesn't want it too wet but conditions this morning look good. ENCAP (10) struggles to win but is going okay and the talent is there.
